c74object.name: j.model
c74object.description: j.model is the central brain in a jamoma model. It parses input, distributes messages to parameters, generates documentation, etc.

method.name: dump
method.digest: Dump all attributes' values out the rightmost outlet
method.description: The dump message outputs all attributes' values out the rightmost outlet

method.name: init
method.description: The init message initializes this model. This message is implemented as a j.message embedded in the j.model object

method.name: preset
method.description: The preset message recalls a preset by its name or by its position (from 1): the stored value of every parameter is sent to it as a command, in the order of priority, then name. A parameter that no longer exists is skipped and named on the console.

method.name: preset:new
method.digest: Store the present state as a preset
method.description: The preset:new message stores the value of every parameter below the model as a preset. A position before the name puts the new preset there; a name that exists is stored again in place.

method.name: preset:update
method.digest: Store the present state into a preset
method.description: The preset:update message stores the present state into an existing preset (the current one if none is named).

method.name: preset:delete
method.description: The preset:delete message removes a preset.

method.name: preset:clear
method.description: The preset:clear message removes every preset of the model.

method.name: preset:names
method.description: The preset:names message answers preset:names followed by the names of the presets, in order, out the rightmost outlet.

method.name: preset:move
method.description: The preset:move message moves a preset to a position in the list (from 1).

method.name: preset:copy
method.description: The preset:copy message stores a copy of a preset under a new name, at the end of the list or at the given position (from 1).

method.name: preset:rename
method.description: The preset:rename message gives a preset another name, which must not be taken.

method.name: preset:interpolate
method.digest: Send a blend of two presets
method.description: The preset:interpolate message sends the blend of two presets; the position goes from 0 (the first preset) to 1 (the second). Numbers and lists of numbers of the same length are interpolated, anything else is taken from the nearer preset.

method.name: preset:mix
method.digest: Send a weighted mix of presets
method.description: The preset:mix message sends the mix of several presets, each followed by its factor; the factors are normalised by their sum.

method.name: preset:read
method.digest: Read presets from a text file
method.description: The preset:read message replaces the presets by those of a text file (a file dialog opens without a file name). If the file is missing or holds no preset nothing changes and the console says why. When the model has initialised, the file named like the patcher with .presets.txt is read from the Max search path and the preset default is recalled.

method.name: preset:read/again
method.description: The preset:read/again message reads the file used last.

method.name: preset:write
method.digest: Write the presets to a text file
method.description: The preset:write message writes the presets as a text file (a save dialog opens without a file name).

method.name: preset:write/again
method.description: The preset:write/again message writes to the file used last.

attribute.name: amenities
attribute.digest: Allow to select j.model's provided services
attribute.description: The amenities attribute selects j.model's provided services to specific needs. The amenities attribute can be set as an argument to its patcher. It will then override amenities defined within the model.

attribute.name: description
attribute.digest: A textual description of the model for auto-documentation purposes
attribute.description: The description attribute sets a textual description of the model for auto-documentation purposes

attribute.name: priority
attribute.digest: The priority of the model - used for preset and cue management
attribute.description: The priority attribute sets the priority of the model. It allows to define the order in which model will be saved/recalled from preset and cue. The priority attribute can be set as an argument to its patcher. It will then override priority defined within the model.

attribute.name: alias
attribute.description: Accepted so that old patchers load; it has no effect yet.

attribute.name: activity
attribute.digest: Report the activity of the model
attribute.description: Accepted so that old patchers load; it has no effect yet.

attribute.name: tags
attribute.description: Accepted so that old patchers load; it has no effect yet.

attribute.name: presets
attribute.description: The file the presets were last read from or written to.
